from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import json,hashlib,sys
root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from control.model_execution.direct_sol_chat import build_request
campaign=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4'
astra_id='A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261008-R4P3'
result=json.loads((campaign/'model_results'/(astra_id+'.json')).read_text())
assert result.get('task_id')==astra_id and result.get('phase')=='ASTRA_PREBUILD' and result.get('model')=='gpt-6-astra'
review=json.loads(result['final'])
assert review.get('decision')=='REVISE','ASTRA_NOT_REVISE'
previous=json.loads((root/'control/model_execution/direct_results/A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261008-R4P3.json').read_text())
prior_req=json.loads((root/'control/model_execution/direct_requests/A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261008-R4P3.json').read_text())
assert previous['task_id']==prior_req['task_id']
assert prior_req['delivery_route_task_id']==previous['worker_route_task_id']
binding=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(review,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
tid='A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261008-R4P4'
prompt=('You are exactly GPT-5.6 Sol in regular Chat mode, not Codex or Work. Revise the R4P3 experiment proposal according to this exact independent GPT-6 Astra PREBUILD REVISE. Return ONLY one complete proposal JSON object, with proposal_version 6 and the SAME THREE EXACT frozen v4 artifact names. Explicitly freeze all input/output and rejection contracts including ask and fee bounds. Supply exact repository-owned harness/guard Python source, concrete deterministic invocation, resource-limit enforcement and bind the source to the postbuild review. Preserve all earlier frozen controls, observations, Decimal precision and tiny-positive edge classification. No build, tests, measurement, trades, network access or paid operations. Keep scientific_status NO_PROVEN_EDGE. Re-submit to exact Astra PREBUILD after revision.\\n'+json.dumps({'astra_review':review,'previous_sol_proposal':json.loads(previous['final']),'previous_proposal_request_id':previous['task_id']},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
req=build_request(task_id=tid,phase='SOL_PROPOSAL',campaign_id=prior_req['campaign_id'],candidate_id=prior_req['candidate_id'],binding_sha256=binding,prompt=prompt,delivery_route_task_id=prior_req['delivery_route_task_id'],created_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z'))
target=root/'control/dev_checks/a2z_r4p4_sol_revision_request.json'
target.write_text(json.dumps(req,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\\n')
print('R4P4_SOL_REVISION_REQUEST=VALIDATED')
print('ASTRA_REVIEW_BINDING_SHA256='+binding)
